input.free_text_description: This system is an authentication platform that serves User, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including oauth 2principal, user registration, password recovered, user registration requested. The platform provides capabilities for mc authentication event handler, base login command handler, email login command handler. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to create and manage oauth 2principal records, so that I can track and organize oauth 2principal data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage user registration records, so that I can track and organize user registration data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage password recovered records, so that I can track and organize password recovered data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage user registration requested records, so that I can track and organize user registration requested data effectively.
